svg.title: Ecologist — Man
svg.desc: A fictional man working as ecologist, wearing a work jacket and a peaked work cap. Visible work cue: A magnifying lens surrounds a six-legged field insect above a separate small leaf specimen. The person is on the left, with the work cue on the right. Occupational headgear: a peaked work cap and round glasses.
